newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Shenzhen B shares retreat at noon on profit-taking.
newsitem.headline: Shenzhen B shares retreat at noon on profit-taking.

text.p: Shenzhen's B share index slumped on Tuesday morning as investors took profits after the recent bull-run towards the end of the annual corporate results reporting season, brokers said.
The B share index fell 3.54 points or 1.95 percent to 178.25 on turnover of HK$92.1 million.
"Investors turned a bit wary with the index having scored year highs for three successive sessions by Monday," an analyst with China Guotai Securities said.
"They also expect the remaining B share firms to release poor 1996 results before the April 30 deadline," the analyst said.
